svg.title: The Six Process Constellations — Clusters and Workflow Blocks around a Shared Data & Agentic Core
svg.desc: Six process constellations (P2P, O2C, P2M, S2S, D2R, MDM) share a governed Data Core and Workflow & Agentic Fabric. Broad segmented arcs represent process clusters; fine outer segments represent workflow blocks within those clusters.
svg.text: Same six every company. Shared Data & Agentic Core. Each business’s own clusters and workflow blocks.

g.text: Record to Report, GL, Cost & FP&A
Hire to Retire, Payroll, Time & LMS

svg.text: Constellation (6 Macro Flows) → Clusters (Broad Arcs) → Workflow Blocks (Fine Outer Segments)
Same six constellations in every enterprise — each business configures its own cluster mix and workflow blocks.
